intro: A glass of watermelon juice from a stall is about 130 kcal (estimate). Most of it is natural sugar from the watermelon, plus the sugar syrup most sellers add.
diet: Yes. Watermelon juice is one of the lowest-calorie juices at a stall. But juice has less fibre than whole fruit, so it's less filling. Ask for no sugar, and don't use it to replace a meal.
tips: Order 'jus tembikai tak nak gula'. Watermelon is sweet enough.
Skip the version mixed with condensed milk.
If available, just eat cut watermelon. It's more filling.

swap.name: Cut watermelon (2 slices)
swap.why: It has fibre, takes longer to eat, and fills you up more for fewer calories.

faq.q: Is watermelon juice good for hydration?
faq.a: Watermelon does have a lot of water. But plain water is still the best choice for daily hydration.

faq.q: Why does stall watermelon juice taste sweeter?
faq.a: Many stalls add sugar syrup so the taste stays consistent. Ask for no sugar if you don't want it.

faq.q: Can I drink watermelon juice at night?
faq.a: Yes. Some people just find they need the toilet more often because it's mostly water.
